ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached figure shows a unit negative feedback sampled system. The input r(t) enters the summing point on the left, and the output y(t) returns to the summing point via the feedback line below and is added with a negative sign; the summing point outputs e(t), which then passes through the sampling element to obtain e*(t). The forward channel sequentially contains a zero-order holder block labeled (1 - e^{-sT})/s, and a continuous plant block labeled 1/(s+a), finally outputting y(t). Reasoning: According to the forward sampled-data path in the figure, first find the pulse transfer function of the continuous plant 1/(s+a) under the action of the zero-order holder. The unit step response of the plant is h(t) = (1 - e^{-at})/a, so after sampling h(kT) = (1 - e^{-akT})/a. Let E = e^{-aT}, then Z{h(kT)} = (1/a)[z/(z-1) - z/(z-E)]. The ZOH pulse transfer function is G(z) = (1 - z^{-1})Z{h(kT)} = (1/a)[1 - (z-1)/(z-E)] = (1 - E)/[a(z-E)], namely G(z) = (1 - e^{-aT})/[a(z - e^{-aT})]. The feedback in the figure is unit negative feedback, so the closed-loop pulse transfer function is C(z)/R(z) = G(z)/(1 + G(z)) = (1 - e^{-aT})/[a(z - e^{-aT}) + 1 - e^{-aT}] = (1 - e^{-aT})/[az + 1 - (a+1)e^{-aT}].

method.method_draft: Identify the forward sampled-data path from the image as a sampler plus ZOH feeding the plant 1/(s+a), with unity negative feedback. Compute the ZOH pulse transfer function of the plant: sample the step response of 1/(s+a), multiply by (1-z^{-1}), and simplify to obtain G(z)=(1-e^{-aT})/[a(z-e^{-aT})]. Finally close the loop using the negative-feedback relation C(z)/R(z)=G(z)/(1+G(z)) and simplify the denominator to reach the stated expression.

图像描述：附图显示一个单位负反馈采样系统。输入 r(t) 进入左侧求和点，输出 y(t) 由下方反馈线回到求和点并以负号相加；求和点输出 e(t)，再经过采样环节得到 e*(t)。前向通道依次包含标为 (1 - e^{-sT})/s 的零阶保持器块，以及标为 1/(s+a) 的连续对象块，最后输出 y(t)。
推理：按图中前向 sampled-data path，先求连续对象 1/(s+a) 在零阶保持器作用下的脉冲传递函数。对象的单位阶跃响应为 h(t) = (1 - e^{-at})/a，因此采样后 h(kT) = (1 - e^{-akT})/a。令 E = e^{-aT}，则 Z{h(kT)} = (1/a)[z/(z-1) - z/(z-E)]。ZOH 脉冲传递函数为 G(z) = (1 - z^{-1})Z{h(kT)} = (1/a)[1 - (z-1)/(z-E)] = (1 - E)/[a(z-E)]，即 G(z) = (1 - e^{-aT})/[a(z - e^{-aT})]。图中反馈为单位负反馈，所以闭环脉冲传递函数为 C(z)/R(z) = G(z)/(1 + G(z)) = (1 - e^{-aT})/[a(z - e^{-aT}) + 1 - e^{-aT}] = (1 - e^{-aT})/[az + 1 - (a+1)e^{-aT}]。

method.method_draft: From the diagram, model the held signal entering 1/(s+a) as constant over each sampling interval. Let alpha=e^{-aT} and beta=(1-alpha)/a. The plant update is y_{k+1}=alpha y_k+beta e_k. The negative unity feedback gives e_k=r_k-y_k. Substitute to get y_{k+1}=(alpha-beta)y_k+beta r_k. Taking the one-sided or zero-initial-condition z-transform gives zY(z)=(alpha-beta)Y(z)+beta R(z), hence Y/R=beta/[z-alpha+beta]. Multiply numerator and denominator by a and substitute alpha=e^{-aT} to obtain (1-e^{-aT})/[a z+1-(a+1)e^{-aT}].

图像描述：图中是一个闭环采样控制系统。左侧输入为 r(t)，进入求和点；输出 y(t) 经下方通道反馈到求和点，并在求和点处以负号相加，所以是单位负反馈。求和点输出标为 e(t)，随后经过采样开关，采样周期标为 T。采样后的信号进入保持环节，方框中为 (1-e^{-sT})/s；之后进入连续对象 1/(s+a)，右侧输出为 y(t)。

推理：按图中零阶保持器的作用，在每个采样区间 [kT,(k+1)T) 内，进入连续对象 1/(s+a) 的信号可视为常值 e_k。令 alpha = e^{-aT}。对一阶对象 1/(s+a)，其微分方程为 y_dot = -a y + e_k，因此从 kT 到 (k+1)T 的离散更新为 y_{k+1} = alpha y_k + beta e_k，其中 beta = (1-alpha)/a。由图中的单位负反馈，采样时刻误差信号满足 e_k = r_k - y_k。代入得到 y_{k+1} = alpha y_k + beta(r_k-y_k) = (alpha-beta)y_k + beta r_k。在零初始条件下取 z 变换，有 zY(z) = (alpha-beta)Y(z) + beta R(z)，因此闭环脉冲传递函数为 Y(z)/R(z) = beta/[z-alpha+beta]。将 beta=(1-alpha)/a 代入并分子分母同乘以 a，得到 Y(z)/R(z) = (1-alpha)/(a z - a alpha + 1 - alpha) = (1-alpha)/(a z + 1 - (a+1)alpha)。最后代入 alpha=e^{-aT}，得到闭环脉冲传递函数为 (1-e^{-aT})/[a z + 1 - (a+1)e^{-aT}]。
